hook: AI hackers put skateboarding inside Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2. Watch what happens.
caption:
AI helped someone put real skateboard tricks inside Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 🛹

A modder bolted skate mechanics onto the 2009 war shooter, and the ollies and grinds move like they were always part of the game.

No slow-mo, no cuts. Just a soldier grinding across the map mid-mission.

Which old game deserves a mod like this next? Tell us below 👇
